questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?
options: I have seen that film last week.
I have seen that film since last week.
I saw that film last week.
I have seen that film yesterday.
questions.answer: I have seen that film since last week.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence with the past perfect tense.
options: When I arrived, the meeting had started.
When I arrived, the meeting started.
When I arrived, the meeting has started.
When I arrived, the meeting was starting.
questions.answer: When I arrived, the meeting had started.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses comparatives for equality?
options: My brother is as tall than me.
My brother is as tall as I.
My brother is as tall as I do.
My brother is as tall as I one.
questions.answer: My brother is as tall as I.

questions.question: Select the correct conditional sentence type 3.
options: If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I studied harder, I will pass the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which modal verb is used to express possibility in the past?
options: could
can
may
must

questions.question: Identify the correct form after 'remember' in reported speech.
options: I remember that he said he was coming.
I remember that he said he is coming.
I remember that he said he will come.
I remember that he said he comes.
questions.answer: I remember that he said he was coming.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a gerund after a preposition?
options: She is good at playing tennis.
She is good at play tennis.
She is good to playing tennis.
She is good for playing tennis.
questions.answer: She is good at playing tennis.

questions.question: Choose the correct infinitive form after 'decide' to express purpose.
options: I decided to go to the cinema.
I decided for go to the cinema.
I decided of going to the cinema.
I decided that I go to the cinema.
questions.answer: I decided to go to the cinema.

questions.question: Select the appropriate linker to connect contrasting ideas.
options: However, he was not late.
Therefore, he was not late.
Moreover, he was not late.
In conclusion, he was not late.

questions.question: Which word best completes this sentence about a common B1-level topic? 'The new regulations aim to ________ the number of accidents on the roads.'
options: decrease
increase
maintain
eliminate
